In one traditional telling, goddess Parvati wanted someone to guard her while she bathed. She shaped a little boy from the turmeric paste she used on her skin and brought him to life. That little boy was Ganesha. 💛

Of course, we heard turmeric and thought… PLAY ♥️

Out came the turmeric, sticks, grass and leaves. The kids made their own nature brushes, dipped them into turmeric paint and got busy painting their Ganeshas.

A little bit of story, a little bit of nature and a whole lot of yellow hands. 💛

We love finding little details in the stories we grew up with and turning them into something kids can actually play with.

Our beloved Ganesha Play Date! 

Ganesha Habba is here, and one of our favourite play dates is back!

This year, Mr. Lokesh joins us again, showing the children how a simple lump of clay can slowly take shape into their very own little Ganesha to take home.

There’ll be flowers to play with, stories about Ganesha, little sweet treats to make, art to create and lots of getting our hands messy.

And of course, it wouldn’t be a LooRoo play date without plenty of nature, sensory play and curious little things to squish, mix, mould and discover along the way.

A morning of making, playing and celebrating Ganesha together! 🐘
